Package org.swarmforge.core.behavior

package org.swarmforge.core.behavior
Core behavior logic including Reasoning Architectures and AI interfaces.

This package defines the brain of the agents, supporting multiple paradigms:

  • Finite State Machines (FSM)
  • Reinforcement Learning (RL)
  • Neural Networks
  • Behavior Trees
